title: tk-hub protocol
description: Every message exchanged between devbox-daemon, hub-server and hub-web. One document is one message; `type` selects its shape. Daemon -> hub: hello, snapshot, rpc_result, synthesis_started, synthesis_finished, synthesis_failed (relayed by the hub to /ws/ui as they are). Hub -> daemon: welcome, refused, rpc. Hub -> UI (/ws/ui): board_synced, board_removed, ticket_moved, synthesis_started, synthesis_finished, synthesis_failed, rpc_result, devbox_status, hub_settings, scheduler_log. A major `protocol_version` mismatch is refused.

protocol_version.description: MAJOR.MINOR. The hub refuses a daemon whose major differs from its own.

timestamp.description: RFC 3339 date-time in UTC, always with a `Z` suffix (no offsets), e.g. 2026-10-23T14:02:11Z.

name.description: A devbox, repo or board name: one path segment.

nn.description: Ticket number as written on the board, zero-padded ("07").

synthesis_status.description: none: never run; running: a backend is working on it; ok: last run succeeded; failed: last run failed and the previous good content is kept.

usage.description: Claude plan usage for the box's account, from ~/.local/state/tk-daemon/usage.json. unknown: no data (window fields null); stale: older than 30 min while agents run, still used. An expired window is reported as 0 %.

sync_result.description: The last `devbox sync` started by sync_box, reported after the daemon reconnects.

exit_code.description: null while it runs or when it was interrupted.

interrupted.description: No exit code and its systemd unit is gone: killed or rebooted mid-sync.

health.description: Sent with hello and with every snapshot. herdr.ok false -> no launches on that box.

status.description: Raw `herdr status server` output (or the error).

running.description: Tickets in column `working` or `review` on this box.

policy.description: Resolved `tk.sh policy <board>` (ticket-skill 02): defaults < box < repo < board, TICKET_FORGE beats forge. Unknown keys pass through.

policy_sources.description: Which layer each resolved policy key came from, for the policy popover (ticket 13).

board_brief.description: Live synthesis of where the board stands (ticket 18), stored in hub-meta.json.

synthesis_error.description: Why the last run failed (synthesis_status failed; the lines above are the previous good brief), else null.

hub_meta.description: Board-level fields of .scratch/<board>/hub-meta.json. Per-ticket fields are merged into each ticket instead.

pr.description: ticket-skill's common PR shape (board-lib.sh gh_norm / az_norm).

source.description: synthesis: written by a synthesis backend (removed by a later run only if unchecked); developer: added by hand, never removed by synthesis.

ticket.description: One `board_rows` row (ticket-skill tk.sh) plus its hub-meta fields. board_rows may grow fields: extra properties are allowed.

file.description: Absolute path of the ticket file.

base.description: Base sha recorded at launch, or empty.

repo.description: The **Repo:** line's repo name, or empty.

state.description: Herdr agent_status (idle, working, blocked, done, unknown…), `-` no agent, `?` Herdr didn't answer, `gone` agent missing.

checks.description: Coordinator-reported checks, e.g. {tests: "pass", criteria: "3/5", review: "ok"}; empty when unknown.

synthesis_error.description: Why the last synthesis run failed (synthesis_status failed), else null.

board.description: One board snapshot: `tk.sh export <board>` (ticket-skill 01: board_id, slug, repo, root, base, has_remote, forge, board_path, board_md, retro_results_md, tickets) merged with project memory, hub-meta and the resolved policy by the daemon. `stale`/`last_seen` are added by the hub. additionalProperties is true, like `ticket`, while the export is still evolving: a new export field must not break validation.

has_remote.description: Whether the repo has the remote tk.sh pushes to; false means no PRs, local merges only.

hash.description: Content hash the daemon uses to send only changed boards.

hello.description: First message from a daemon on /ws/daemon.

refused.description: Hub refuses the daemon (bad token, major protocol_version mismatch) and closes the socket.

snapshot.description: Daemon -> hub. full: every board on the box (boards absent are removed); otherwise only boards whose hash changed, plus `removed`.

rpc_method.description: The fixed RPC list. The daemon rejects anything else.

rpc.description: Hub -> daemon. Timeouts: 10 min for synthesis RPCs (refine_with_comment, refresh_board_brief, run_retro), 2 min for the rest.

params_launch_ticket.description: tk.sh launch <board> <NN> --type --model --effort. manual: true bypasses max_parallel and the usage gate (flagged).

params_set_policy.description: tk.sh policy-set <board> key=value… on the board override file.

values.description: Board-override keys to write; null removes the board override (the key inherits again).

params_set_task_done.description: Tasks are matched by normalised text.

params_add_manual_task.description: Adds a developer item (source: developer) to the checklist.

params_sync_box.description: Refused while any ticket on the box is working unless force.

params_get_diff.description: Without file: the file list with stats and diff_hash; with file: that file's unified diff.

params_set_review_comments.description: Replaces the ticket's draft review comments in hub-meta.

rpc_result.description: Daemon -> hub reply to an rpc, and hub -> UI forward of it (the hub adds devbox, method, board_key, nn); a result the hub holds a waiter for (get_diff) goes only to that REST caller, not to /ws/ui. `data` carries structured results (get_diff, verify_landed, sweep_board, pane_tail…); `reason` a human explanation of a refusal.

exit_code.description: null when the command never ran (refused, timed out).

board_removed.description: The board vanished from its box (absent from a full snapshot or listed in `removed`).

ticket_moved.description: Derived by the hub by diffing `col` between snapshots; also stored in the activity log.

changes_requested.description: A review round in the activity log: Request changes sent the ticket's draft comments to its agent as one tk.sh say (the hub records it on that rpc_result's ok).

comments.description: How many comments the message carried.

synthesis_event.description: synthesis_started / synthesis_finished, daemon -> hub -> UI. nn null: the board brief. backend: the backend about to run (started) or that produced the result (finished).

synthesis_failed.description: Every backend failed; the last good hub-meta is kept. Daemon -> hub -> UI. backend: the last one tried; error: each backend's reason.

devbox_status.description: A box connected, disconnected (its boards go stale), was refused, or sent new health.

refused_reason.description: Set when the hub refused the daemon (e.g. major protocol_version mismatch), shown in the UI.

hub_settings_values.description: Hub-only settings (SQLite). total_cap: running tickets across every box (board.md, Scheduler). waves: ▶ Run waves (board.md's ☾ Night, reworked: no time of day, no auto-off time) arms night_shift boards as auto and opens PRs / pushes / merges where policy allows, from waves_start (null: from when it was turned on) until nothing is left to launch, ship or merge (no frontier, and every started ticket has shipped as far as its board's policy allows or waits for a human), or, with nothing still moving, every remaining launch is held by the usage gate; then the hub turns it off and logs why.

hub_settings.description: Hub -> UI: the hub settings changed (from a UI, or the scheduler turning ▶ Run waves off).

scheduler_entry.description: One scheduler decision. sent: an automatic rpc went out (reason: frontier or waves); skipped: a candidate waits, and why (logged when the reason changes); failed: an automatic rpc failed or was refused (retried after a cooldown); waves_off: ▶ Run waves turned itself off, and why.

scheduler_log.description: Hub -> UI: a new scheduler decision.

rest_boards.description: REST: GET /api/boards. Every board the hub holds (stale ones included) and every devbox it has heard from.

rest_report.description: REST: GET /api/boards/{board_key}/tickets/{nn}/report. body: the ticket file's raw text when the daemon sends it as the ticket's `body`, else null.

rest_diff.description: REST: GET /api/boards/{board_key}/tickets/{nn}/diff[?file=]. The daemon's get_diff data, as is: `files` (path, status M/A/D/R, old_path on R, added, removed, binary) without ?file=, at most the daemon's diff_max_files of them (`truncated` true then, `total_files` the real count; diff_hash still covers all); with it that file's entry plus `diff` (unified; empty when stubbed) and `stub` (null, "binary", "over_cap" or "nested_repo"). diff_hash identifies the whole diff, untracked files included (an untracked nested repo, listed as `nested_repo: true` with a trailing slash in its path, by its HEAD only). An untracked file over the daemon's read limit (or past its per-request byte budget) is identified by its stat (inode, size, mtime, ctime, mode), so a mere touch on it changes diff_hash. Errors (rest_error): 404 unknown board, ticket or file, 409 devbox offline (or gone mid-request) or ticket without worktree/base, 504 timed out, 502 any other refusal or failure.

rest_activity.description: REST: GET /api/boards/{board_key}/tickets/{nn}/activity. The ticket's column moves and review rounds, oldest first.

rest_scan.description: REST: POST /api/scan (body {devbox?}, or empty for every connected devbox) -> 202. One rescan_boards rpc per devbox reached; each rpc_result arrives on /ws/ui.

rest_action_request.description: REST: POST /api/boards/{board_key}/tickets/{nn}/action body. One ticket RPC for the board's daemon; the hub adds board_key and nn to params, and the whole rpc must then match the schema (else 422).

rest_action.description: REST: 202 from POST /api/boards/{board_key}/tickets/{nn}/action (one rpc) and POST /api/boards/{board_key}/frontier (one launch_ticket per backlog ticket, manual false, with its suggested model/effort; skipped: the backlog tickets it could not launch). 409 when the devbox is not connected. Each rpc_result arrives on /ws/ui.

rest_archive.description: REST: POST /api/boards/{key}/archive, body {archived: boolean} -> 202, one set_archived rpc to the board's devbox; its rpc_result arrives on /ws/ui. 404 unknown board, 409 devbox offline, 422 bad body (see rest_error).

rest_sync_box.description: REST: POST /api/devboxes/{devbox}/sync, body {force?: boolean} -> 202, one sync_box rpc to the devbox; the outcome arrives as health.last_sync after the daemon reconnects. 409 devbox offline, 422 bad body (see rest_error).

rest_board_brief.description: REST: POST /api/boards/{key}/brief (no body) -> 202, one refresh_board_brief rpc to the board's devbox: a board-brief synthesis run now. synthesis_* events (nn null) and the rpc_result arrive on /ws/ui. 404 unknown board, 409 devbox offline.

rest_propose_memory.description: REST: POST /api/boards/{key}/memory, body {text} -> 202, one propose_memory rpc to the board's devbox; the daemon appends a project-memory ticket to the board (the hub never writes project-memory.md). 404 unknown board or devbox offline, 422 empty text (see rest_error).

rest_set_policy.description: REST: POST /api/boards/{key}/policy (body {values}: the board-override keys to change, as in params_set_policy) -> 202. One set_policy rpc to the board's devbox; its rpc_result arrives on /ws/ui, the new resolved policy in the board's next snapshot.

rest_refine.description: REST: POST /api/boards/{key}/tickets/{nn}/comment, body {comment: string, may be empty} -> 202, one refine_with_comment rpc to the board's devbox: a synthesis run with the developer's comment. synthesis_* events and the rpc_result arrive on /ws/ui. 404 unknown board or ticket, 409 devbox offline, 422 bad body.

rest_set_task_done.description: REST: POST /api/boards/{key}/tickets/{nn}/tasks, body {text, done} (the checklist item, matched by normalised text) -> 202, one set_task_done rpc to the board's devbox; the tick arrives with the board's next snapshot. 404 unknown board or ticket, 409 devbox offline, 422 bad body.

rest_settings.description: REST: GET /api/settings, and POST /api/settings (body: any of total_cap, waves, waves_start; waves_start only with waves: true, else 422; turning waves off clears waves_start) -> 200 with the settings after the change. 422 bad or empty body.

rest_scheduler.description: REST: GET /api/scheduler. The scheduler's latest decisions (at most 100), newest first.

rest_error.description: REST: any 4xx/5xx. detail is a message, or FastAPI's list of validation errors (422).
